title: Voluntary Contributions to the Reserve Account
content:
An account in the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts that sits in Contributory — Experience-Rated Positive Reserve or Contributory — Experience-Rated Deficit Reserve may buy a lower rate by paying a voluntary contribution into its reserve. The new employer, delinquent reporting and reimbursing classes may not. The class is the one on the account in the Department's records.

## Time limit

A voluntary contribution is accepted only when it is received no later than the voluntary contribution window after the rate notice mailing date. The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the rate notice mailing date, and a contribution received on the last day is in time. The mailing date is the rate notice date recorded on the account.

**Both sides of the window (hypothetical, window of 30 calendar days).** For a notice mailed on 10 December, day 1 of the window is 11 December and the last day is 9 January. A contribution received on 9 January is in time; one received on 10 January is not.

## Amount needed for the next lower rate

The amount needed to reach the next lower rate is the floor of the next schedule row multiplied by the average annual taxable payroll, less the reserve balance at the computation date, never below zero and rounded up to the next whole dollar.

- The **next schedule row** is the row directly above the row that produced the rate on the latest rate notice. An account already at the lowest rate of its schedule has no next lower rate.
- The **reserve balance at the computation date** is the reserve credits less the benefit charges and transfers out booked on or before the computation date preceding the rate year.
- A smaller payment lowers nothing, and it is still credited to the reserve.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** The reserve balance at the computation date is USD 42,000.00 and the average annual taxable payroll is USD 987,654.32. The latest notice's rate came from the row with floor 0.0400, and the row directly above it has floor 0.0600. The floor multiplied by the payroll is 59,259.2592; less 42,000.00 that leaves 17,259.2592, which rounds up to USD 17,260.00. A payment of USD 17,000.00 would lower nothing but would still be credited to the reserve.

## After the contribution

A voluntary contribution is never refunded and never applied to the balance due. It produces a revised rate notice for the same rate year.
